jobs.content: <p>職位概述<br>身為 Coupang 的 Facility Design Principal，您將負責規劃與設計快速成長中的物流履約中心（Fulfillment Center）及配送中心網絡。您將與 Operations、Process、EHS、Security、Fire Safety 等跨部門團隊合作，設計高效率、可擴展且安全的物流中心配置，以最大化產能並優化物流作業流程。<br><br>此職位為台灣 Facility Design 團隊的首位成員，將作為台灣與區域團隊之間的重要橋樑，負責推動大型物流設施、自動化系統及機器人技術的規劃與導入，支援 Coupang 在台灣持續擴張的物流網絡。<br>&nbsp;<br>工作內容&nbsp;<br>• 根據營運需求、作業流程、儲位規劃及產能需求，規劃與設計物流中心整體配置（Facility Layout Design）。<br>• 蒐集並整合各部門需求，設計及優化物流中心空間配置、作業動線及儲位規劃。<br>• 運用 AutoCAD 建立、維護及優化物流中心配置圖面。<br>• 規劃與優化物流自動化系統，包括 Conveyor、Sorter、Robotics 等設備配置。<br>• 分析現場實際作業情況及歷史數據，提出提升產能、效率及空間利用率的改善方案。<br>• 與 Operations、Process、EHS、Security 及 Fire Safety 等團隊密切合作，推動並取得設計方案核准（Design Sign-off）。<br>• 與供應商及內外部合作夥伴協調，確保專案需求被正確執行並如期交付。<br>• 擔任台灣 Facility Design 團隊代表，快速回應在地及區域 Stakeholders 的設計需求。<br>• 運用 Excel 及 SQL 進行數據分析，支援物流中心設計決策與產能規劃。<br>• 領導及推動物流中心設計、自動化導入及流程改善專案，確保專案按時完成。<br>• 與區域及全球團隊合作，導入最佳實務並建立可規模化的物流設計解決方案。<br>&nbsp;<br>基本資格條件<br>• 機械工程、土木工程、工業工程、供應鏈管理、物流管理、營運管理或相關科系學士以上學歷。<br>• 7 年以上大型物流中心、履約中心（Fulfillment Center）或配送中心相關設施設計經驗。<br>• 熟悉物流中心配置規劃（Warehouse Layout Design）及儲位設計（Storage Design）。<br>• 熟悉物流自動化系統規劃，包括 Conveyor、Sorter、Robotics 或相關 MHE 設備。<br>• 熟練使用 AutoCAD，具備大型設施配置規劃與圖面管理經驗。<br>• 具備跨部門 Stakeholder Management 經驗，能有效協調多個團隊共同推動專案。<br>• 具備優秀的專案管理及問題解決能力。<br>• 熟悉 Excel 數據分析。<br>• 具備基礎 SQL 查詢能力，能理解查詢邏輯並利用工具進行資料擷取與分析。<br>• 具備良好的英文口語及書面溝通能力，能與國際團隊及外籍 Stakeholders 順暢合作。<br>• 能夠在快速變動且高節奏的環境中同時管理多項專案及優先事項。<br>&nbsp;<br>加分條件<br>• 機械工程或土木工程背景。<br>• 具備大型物流中心自動化專案規劃及導入經驗。<br>• 曾參與物流中心新建、擴建或重大改造專案。<br>• 具備 Storage Profiling、Capacity Planning 或 Throughput Optimization 相關經驗。<br>• 具備 Capex Estimation 及專案投資評估經驗。<br>• 曾與區域或跨國團隊合作推動大型專案。<br>• 熟悉物流、電子商務、供應鏈或大型倉儲環境。<br>• 具備優秀的資料分析能力及 Excel 應用能力。<br>• 能在無直接管理權限下成功影響決策並推動跨部門合作。</p>

<p>酷澎是世界上成長最快、最創新的公司之一，並達成美國史上科技業第五大的首次公開募股。我們擁有卓越的端到端電子商務及物流網絡，極力擁抱客戶為重的文化，並創下領先全球的創新紀錄。<br><br>酷澎打破傳統電子商務的權衡限制，讓顧客能享受閃電般迅速的運輸服務，以最低的價格，購得數百萬種商品。酷澎在韓國、美國和中國皆有辦公室，新創人才在這裡可以把握新機會，採取主動，發光發熱。<br>現在，酷澎首次要在台灣招募創始團隊了。<br><br>酷澎希望招募的值班組長，是對電子商務懷抱熱誠，願意跟我們一起建造物流中心的營運流程，在自己的人生中，寫下一段成功的故事。<br><br>只要你對電商市場懷抱熱誠，且相信自己有清晰的溝通能力，快速的學習力，不論你來自什麼學校，什麼背景，我們都歡迎你！</p>
<p>✅職務概覽：<br>· 管理倉庫的日常營運流程，例如顧客商品出貨、材料入庫、存貨管理<br>· 現場人員管理及排班、教育訓練、工作任務指派、成效執行追蹤<br>· 確保顧客商品運輸符合流程，並遵守安全規章<br>· 盡其所能優先滿足顧客商品運輸的服務水平<br>· 維持存貨的理想狀態<br>· 遵守主管機關訂定的品質標準<br><br>✅招募條件：<br>· 臨場反應快速，能快速判斷工作優先順序<br>· 個性積極主動、抗壓性強，注意細節<br>· 決策迅速，積極為顧客發聲<br>· 在高度創新的高速環境中，能達成有挑戰性的目標<br>· 對電子商務市場具備高度熱情<br>· 可配合輪班制工作<br>· 善溝通協調者，具團隊管理經驗<br><br>✅上班時間：<br>08:00~02:00 時段內排班、輪班。<br>(14:00後另有特殊班別津貼)</p>

jobs.content: <p>About the Role<br>Coupang is disrupting the retail experience by building world-class technology that<br>serves millions of customers and sellers every day. The Finance Platform &amp; Accounting<br>Engineering (FPE) team builds the backbone of Coupang’s enterprise finance<br>infrastructure—processing millions of transactions daily, driving high-scale ledger<br>automation, and empowering internal accounting and operational teams with accurate,<br>real-time financial data.<br><br>As a Senior Product Manager in FPE, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and<br>execution for Coupang’s internal finance and accounting platforms. You will bridge<br>complex financial domain logic with scalable distributed systems, working backwards<br>from internal finance, accounting, tax, and audit stakeholders to build automated, highly<br>reliable, and compliant platform products.<br>Key Responsibilities<br>• Define Strategy &amp; Roadmap: Build product vision, strategy, and multi-year<br>roadmap for Coupang's core finance and accounting platform products, aligning<br>technical architecture with business growth and regulatory requirements.<br>• End-to-End Product Lifecycle: Lead cross-functional execution from discovery<br>and technical requirements gathering (PRDs) through design, build, deployment,<br>and post-launch optimization alongside dedicated engineering, data science, and<br>accounting operational teams.<br>• Accounting &amp; Operations Partnership: Partner directly with Coupang’s<br>Controllership, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit teams to deeply<br>understand their workflows, automate manual month-end processes, streamline<br>continuous closing capabilities and automate accounting operations.<br>• Backlog &amp; Execution Management: Author granular user stories, technical<br>specifications, and clear acceptance criteria; maintain a well-prioritized backlog<br>in an agile framework to ensure high-velocity, defect-free delivery.<br>• Data Integrity &amp; Automation: Establish product metrics and key performance<br>indicators (KPIs) focused on data accuracy, reconciliation speed, automated<br>ledger entry rates, and system processing latency.<br>• Stakeholder Communication &amp; Leadership: Present product updates,<br>architecture decisions, and strategic trade-offs to senior finance and technology<br>leadership, building alignment across business units.<br>• Coupang Leadership Principles: Embody a customer-first (and internal user-<br>first) mindset, obsessing over operational efficiency, operational rigor, and zero-<br>defect financial reporting.<br><br>Basic Qualifications<br>• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems,<br>Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related technical/quantitative field.<br>• Experience: 8+ years of product management, program management, solutions<br>architecture, or software development experience delivering large-scale,<br>enterprise-grade software products.<br>• Domain &amp; Analytical Skills: Proven ability to break down complex financial<br>processes into scalable software requirements; highly data-driven with<br>exceptional problem-solving abilities.<br>• Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with a<br>track record of clearly conveying complex technical concepts to non-technical<br>finance partners and executive leadership.<br>• Execution Track Record: Proven ability to manage competing priorities, drive<br>alignment in matrixed organizations, and consistently deliver complex platform<br>initiatives under tight timelines.<br>• Customer Obsession: Strong commitment to working backwards from user pain<br>points to deliver intuitive, high-impact internal platforms and tools.<br>Preferred Qualifications<br><br>• Education: Engineering undergraduate, computer science or equivalent<br>advanced degree.<br>• Platform &amp; API Architecture: Prior experience defining APIs, data pipelines,<br>microservices, or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) capabilities for enterprise internal<br>users.<br>• Financial Systems Expertise: Preferred if you have understanding of core<br>accounting principles, general ledgers, sub-ledgers, revenue recognition, tax<br>engine integrations, or enterprise ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle Financials).<br>• E-Commerce &amp; Scale: Preferred if Direct experience in e-commerce, fintech,<br>high-frequency transactional platforms, or payment gateway architecture.</p>

<p>We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry. We are one of the fastest-growing retail companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a leading and reliable force in the commerce industry.<br><br>We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. At Coupang, every day is filled with the excitement of building, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.<br><br>Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and challenge traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic impact in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world</p>
<p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Job Overview<br><br>• Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap and KPIs.<br>• Manage the entire product life cycle from inception to launch, including writing product requirements, defining use cases, and setting success metrics<br>• Define new projects with clear goals and timelines achieved through multi-party<br>communication and detailed project management processes<br>• Inspire the team with the product vision and work cross-functionally to bring the product to life<br>• Own and drive improvements including running A/B tests and impact analysis of the features you ship<br><br>Qualifications<br>• 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of developing and executing a compelling product vision<br>• Analytical thinker who works well in a fast-paced, data-driven and highly ambiguous entrepreneurial culture<br>Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects<br>• Bias for action and willingness to get your hands dirty to get the job done<br>• Sound business judgment and proven ability to effectively communicate and influence others<br>• Superior verbal and written communications skills<br>• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Statistics or equivalent experience<br><br>Preferred<br>• Prior product management experience in Finance, Settlement and Payments related products</p>

jobs.content: <p>關於團隊<br>FinTech UX 團隊負責打造 Coupang 生態系中的直覺化、值得信賴且具可擴展性的金融服務體驗。我們的使命是透過建立卓越的支付體驗，幫助顧客輕鬆且安心地完成付款，進一步消除電商流程中的各種摩擦與障礙。<br>作為台灣支付（Taiwan Payments）團隊的資深產品設計師（Staff Product Designer），您將負責規劃並推動關鍵支付體驗的設計策略與執行，涵蓋整個顧客旅程。您將與產品管理、工程、資料科學、商務、營運、風險管理、法務合規及行銷團隊密切合作，共同定義台灣支付服務的未來藍圖。<br>這是一個高度策略性的個人貢獻者（Individual Contributor, IC）職位，適合能夠親自參與設計工作、善於面對不確定性、影響產品發展方向，並創造實質商業與客戶價值的設計領導者。<br><br><br>【工作內容】<br><br>• 主導台灣支付產品與體驗的端到端設計流程，從策略制定、設計執行到後續優化。<br>• 定義使用者體驗（UX）願景，影響產品策略，並規劃支付體驗發展藍圖（Roadmap）。<br>• 設計流暢且值得信賴的支付旅程，涵蓋結帳流程（Checkout）、電子錢包（Wallet）、身份驗證（Authentication）及未來金融科技產品。<br>• 領導具高度不確定性的 0→1 創新專案，打造全新的支付體驗，創造客戶與商業價值。<br>• 將使用者洞察、商業目標、技術限制及法規要求轉化為直覺且易用的產品體驗。<br>• 透過使用者研究、數據分析、產品實驗及市場洞察，發掘機會並推動可衡量的商業成果。<br>• 定義成功指標，持續改善轉換率（Conversion）、支付成功率、產品採用率及顧客信任度。<br>• 建立可擴展的設計框架、設計模式（Design Patterns）及支付體驗相關 UX 標準。<br>• 與產品、工程、資料科學、風險管理、法務、合規及商業團隊緊密合作，交付高品質解決方案，並影響組織層級決策。<br>&nbsp;<br><br>【條件要求】<br>&nbsp;<br>• 平面設計、互動設計、工業設計、人機互動（HCI）、資訊工程、心理學或相關科系學位，或具同等工作經驗。<br>• 8年以上產品設計（Product Design）、使用者體驗設計（UX Design）或相關領域工作經驗。<br>• 具備設計並成功推出面向消費者數位產品的實務經驗。<br>• 擁有優秀作品集，能展現策略思維、UX問題解決能力、互動設計、視覺設計能力及可衡量的商業成果。<br>• 曾主導複雜、高度模糊且跨部門合作的專案，從概念發想到正式上線。<br>• 精通以使用者為中心（User-Centered Design）的設計方法與完整產品設計流程。<br>• 熟練使用 Figma 及現代設計工具。<br>• 能透過簡報、敘事能力（Storytelling）及數據清楚表達設計理念與決策依據。<br>• 具備與產品管理及工程團隊密切合作的經驗。<br>• 具備優秀的跨部門協作與利害關係人管理能力。<br>• 具備流利中文及英文溝通能力。<br><br>&nbsp;<br>【加分條件】<br><br>• 具備支付（Payments）、金融科技（FinTech）、銀行、電子錢包、貸款、信用卡或金融服務產品設計經驗。<br>• 曾參與台灣或其他亞太地區（APAC）市場產品設計工作。<br>• 深入了解支付生態系統、風險控管、身份驗證、防詐騙機制及相關法規要求。<br>• 具備運用使用者研究與數據分析推動產品策略制定的經驗。<br>• 曾在高速成長且大規模運作的組織環境中工作。<br>• 具備電子商務（E-commerce）、平台市集（Marketplace）或大型消費者產品平台相關經驗。<br>• 曾成功影響高階主管決策並推動組織共識建立。<br>• 能夠整合質化與量化研究成果，轉化為具體可執行的產品與設計決策。</p>
